adrs.title: Current Worker topology is W01-W04; W05/W06 are reserved capability labels
adrs.decision: Keep W01/W02/W03/W04 as the only independently deployable Workers at the current foundation baseline. Reliability and Placement/Migration remain capability domains. W05/W06 require a new approved topology ADR before independent deployment.
adrs.rollback_impact: Reopening Worker topology requires a new topology ADR and migration review.
